versions.content: The SW-Component template shall support integrity and scaling at ports 39 of 57  AUTOSAR CONFIDENTIAL  Document ID 212: AUTOSAR_RS_SoftwareComponentTemplate Requirements on Software Component Template AUTOSAR CP R19-11 Type: valid Description: Specify means to connect ports with incompatible interfaces and to use lower resolution data types for low bandwidth inter-ECU communication. Rationale: Be able to ensure that the port interface conversions between SWC are consistent. Use Case: The engineer shall be able to connect ports with incompatible interfaces without any need for explicitly specifying a conversion formula. The re-scaling of the data shall be done automatically. The engineer shall be able to select an alternative data type if data is communicated inter-ECU instead of intra-ECU. The conversion between the internal data type and the data type sent over the network shall be done automatically. Maintain integrity of re-scaled/converted data. Dependencies:  Supporting Material: 
